Print the active token (for scripts)

Print the token rp would sign requests with, followed by a newline, for use in
scripts:

```
TOKEN=$(rp auth token)
```

This is the one command that prints a secret on purpose. Anyone who sees the
token can act as you, so do not paste it into chat, tickets or logs. On a
terminal rp warns on stderr before printing. A login session is refreshed first
when it is about to expire.

It prints the raw token only, so --output and --jq are not supported. Exit code
4 when there is no credential.

```
rp auth token
```
